The Centre

Silence, land, and a living practice

SoulSong sits on open land at Tungat, near Pandharpur — the town of Vitthal, where pilgrims have walked for centuries. The centre is simple by design: earth, sky, a path, a hall for sitting, and space enough to breathe.

Here we offer yoga, meditation, Ayurveda, and creative writing. Courses run both on the land and online, so you can begin from wherever you are, and come to the fields when you are ready.

Vision for the land at Tungat, near Pandharpur

The Founder

Shri Ramteerth

Shriram S Yadav · Founder · Meditation facilitator · Columnist · Screenwriter

Shri Ramteerth (Shriram S Yadav) is a meditation facilitator, columnist, screenwriter and entrepreneur. He founded SoulSong to bring yoga, Ayurveda, inner work and the creative arts onto open land near Pandharpur — a place to sit, to heal, and to listen.
